title: 第15章 别打她的主意第16章 权力再大也是个无后的
lines: 午间的避风亭，吹来一阵热风，郁热中捎带着湖水的清凉。
亭围环着蓊郁的树木，枝条散漫开，在亭中投下一片绿影。
风过时，树叶翻腾，簌簌作响。
亭中两男子，一站一立。
立着的那人手背在身后，二十多岁的模样。
一身珊瑚赫圆领袍，领缘露出半指宽素白里衣，腰间束玄色革带，悬羊脂玉镂空香球，挎着一把小银刀，足踏乌皮长靴，鞋头略翘绣如意暗纹。
男子将刚才的一幕看在眼里，轻笑出声：“咱们府里几时进来这么个妙人儿，哪里是在劝架，分明是在拱火，完了嘴里还念罪过，有些意趣。
年轻男子回过身，看向桌边坐着的另一人，说道：“大哥怎的不言语。”
这桌边坐着之人正是陆家大爷，陆铭章，而说话之人看起来比他年轻几岁，是陆家三爷，陆铭川。
只见陆铭章双目端凝，指尖拈着一个清水色宽口盏。
那茶盏线条干净利落，无一丝冗馀，通体釉色是一种温润的影青，光泽内蕴。
桌边双层雕镂的梨花木匣中睡着三个同样式的宽口盏。
正当陆铭川以为他大哥不会开口时，陆铭章的目光从青盏上移开，放远了一点，不知想到什么，启口道：“按辈分，她该叫你一声叔父。”
陆铭川一噎，问道：“亲戚？”
语调中似有遗撼。
“谢家的表亲。”
陆铭章说道。
陆铭川想了半天，才映射上这谢家是哪家，然后无心地笑了笑。
“这次给大哥带的茶器，哥哥可还满意？”
陆铭章将手里的盏放下：“品相不错。”
陆铭川坐到对面，想得自家兄长两句好话，谁知他说道：“这次调你回来，若是再闯祸，便从府里出去，自立门户。”
陆铭川知道兄长的话语虽温，可话里的意思并不温和，从他嘴里出来的话从不虚言废语。
他想要自辩，终是没有开口，毕竟当年年轻气盛，牵扯到人命。
他原任职于太常寺，后失手打死了人，遭到贬谪，不得不离京做了两年地方官，就这还是大哥保着他，否则要受牢狱之灾。
起因要追朔到两年前。
那年，他同一众友人正在楼子里喝酒，跟前叫了几个唱曲儿的。
“廷之，陆相乃你兄长，怎的你还只在太常寺游闲？空有一身好拳脚，你这品级当往上再提一提。”
一锦衣男子问道。
陆铭川，字廷之，时人私下相交，皆以字相互称呼，以表尊重。
此时陆铭川身上已有酒意，听了那话，视线横向那人：“我兄长是我兄长，我是我，不可混肴。”
那人亦有几分醉意，未听出陆铭川话里的不快，不依不饶道：“我看就是陆相不看重你，不将你当自家兄弟。”
桌上众人都喝了酒，有些还算清醒，听了这话，赶紧去拉扯那人，示意他住嘴，不可再往下说。
偏那人酒品不好，喝了酒便张狂，本就存了挑拨之心，借着酒劲把往日的憋屈一股脑地泄出。
他早就看陆铭川不顺眼，太常寺那些人成日想着怎么讨好他，就连他们的顶头上司对他说话也与别个不同。
还不是看在他有一位掌权的兄长。
相比之下，自己这一路的摸爬滚打算什么，简直就是笑话。
content_en:
In the wind shelter at noon, a gust of hot wind blew, bringing with it the coolness of the lake water.
The pavilion is surrounded by lush trees, and their branches are spread out, casting a green shadow in the pavilion.
When the wind blows, the leaves turn and rustle.
There are two men in the pavilion, one standing and the other standing.
The standing man had his hands behind his back and looked to be in his twenties.
Wearing a coral robe with a round collar, a half-finger-wide plain white lining exposed at the collar, a black leather belt around the waist, a hollow suet-fat jade fragrant ball, a small silver knife on the shoulder, and black leather boots with a slightly raised toe embroidered with Ruyi dark patterns.
The man saw the scene just now and chuckled: "When did such a wonderful person come into our house? He was not trying to stop a fight, but he was clearly trying to make a fuss. After that, he was still talking about his sins, which was a bit interesting.
The young man turned around, looked at the other person sitting at the table, and said, "Why is the elder brother silent? "
The person sitting at the table is Lu Mingzhang, the eldest son of the Lu family, and the person speaking looks to be a few years younger than him, Lu Mingchuan, the third eldest son of the Lu family.
Lu Mingzhang's eyes were fixed, and he held a clear water-colored wide-mouthed lamp at his fingertips.
The lines of the tea cup are clean and neat, without a trace of redundancy. The glaze color of the whole body is a warm shadow green with inherent luster.
Three wide-mouthed lamps of the same style sleep in a double-layered carved pear wood box beside the table.
Just when Lu Mingchuan thought that his eldest brother would not speak, Lu Mingzhang moved his eyes away from the Qingzhan, looked a little further away, and without knowing what he thought of, he said: "According to her seniority, she should call you uncle. "
Lu Mingchuan choked and asked, "Relatives? "
There seemed to be a hint of shock in his tone.
"Xie's cousin. "
Lu Mingzhang said.
Lu Mingchuan thought for a long time before he figured out which Xie family it was, and then smiled carelessly.
"Are you satisfied with the tea utensils I brought to you this time? "
Lu Mingzhang put down the lamp in his hand: "It's in good condition. "
Lu Mingchuan sat across from him and thought of some kind words from his brother, but unexpectedly he said: "If you come back this time, if you get into trouble again, you will leave the house and start your own business. "
Lu Mingchuan knew that although his brother's words were gentle, the meaning behind them was not gentle. The words that came out of his mouth were never empty words.
He wanted to defend himself, but he didn't say anything. After all, he was young and energetic, and human lives were involved.
He used to work in Taichang Temple, but he accidentally killed someone and was demoted. He had to leave the capital to serve as a local official for two years. It was his eldest brother who protected him, otherwise he would be imprisoned.
The cause dates back to two years ago.
That year, he and his friends were drinking in a building and called some singers in front of them.
"Tingzhi, Prime Minister Lu is your elder brother, why are you still just hanging out in Taichang Temple? You have good fists and kicks, so your level should be improved upon. "
A man in brocade clothes asked.
Lu Mingchuan, whose courtesy name was Tingzhi. When people met in private at that time, they all called each other by the same name to show respect.
At this time, Lu Mingchuan was already drunk. After hearing those words, he looked at the man: "My brother is my brother, and I am who I am, and we can't mess with him. "
The man was also a bit drunk and did not hear the displeasure in Lu Mingchuan's words, so he said reluctantly: "I think Prime Minister Lu doesn't value you and doesn't treat you as his brother. "
Everyone at the table had drunk wine, and some were still sober. After hearing this, they quickly grabbed the man and signaled him to shut up and stop talking.
But that person was not a good drinker. He became arrogant after drinking. He had a provocative intention and used the power of alcohol to let out all the grievances he had felt in the past.
He had long disliked Lu Mingchuan. Those in Taichang Temple were always thinking about how to please him. Even their immediate superiors spoke to him differently.
Not because he has an older brother who is in power.
In comparison, what he planned to do all this time was simply a joke.
title_en: Chapter 15 Don’t mess with her Chapter 16 No matter how powerful you are, you will still have no heirs.
